svg.text: One open Iceberg catalog across BigQuery, BigQuery AI, and Apache Spark
Query the same federated tables via cache-accelerated BigQuery SQL or credential-vended PySpark 2.3

g.text: Engine A: BigQuery SQL & Gemini 4 AI (cache-backed)
Engine B: Managed Service for Apache Spark 2.3
Reads Iceberg tables & views via S3FileIO / GCSFileIO
Outbound S3 route for Spark executors
